assessment.guidance: Judge the final work yourself. Packaging checks are not quality scores.

prompt: make a static webapp showing a 3d interactive snow globe showing a scene with a snow-capped peak

settings.thinkingBudgetBasis: CLI/model default; no explicit token budget

artifact.note: index.html is a complete self-contained WebGL snow globe: procedural snow-capped mountain, pines, snowy mound, lathe pedestal, fresnel glass sphere (back+front pass), 720 GPU snow particles with gravity/turbulence/collision, orbit-drag, wheel zoom, and click/button shake with camera wobble. WebGL state (DEPTH_TEST, CULL_FACE, outward winding) is explicitly configured so layering is correct. No external assets or network calls.
